title: RentGuard Renters Policy — Late Charges on Overdue Installments
content:
Under the RentGuard Renters Policy, an installment of the term premium that stays unpaid beyond its late-fee grace period carries a late charge on the policy's premium account.

## Rule

1. A renters installment still unpaid after its late-fee grace period carries one late charge, posted as one fee entry with fee code late fee referencing the term and the installment number of the overdue installment.
2. An installment whose payment was returned unpaid is unpaid from its due date, the returned payment counting as never received.
3. The returned-payment fee is charged once per returned payment, referencing that return, and the reinstatement fee once per reinstatement; a late fee is charged at the late charge worked out under this rule instead of at the tier's late fee alone; a fee whose tier amount is 0.00 is not charged at all.

### Reading the rule

| Situation on the premium account | Late charge |
|---|---|
| Installment still unpaid after its late-fee grace period | One late charge, one fee entry with fee code late fee against that term and installment number |
| Installment paid, but that payment was later returned unpaid by the bank | Treated as unpaid from its due date, as though the payment had never been received |
| Returned payment | Its own returned-payment fee, once per return, referencing that return |
| Reinstatement | Its own reinstatement fee, once per reinstatement |

The late charge is an entry on the premium account: it raises the premium balance owed by its amount and is shown against the term and installment it relates to.

## Posting the late charge: `assess_late_charge_664a192e`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool charges one late charge on one installment of one RentGuard renters policy. One call records a single fee entry of type late fee on the policy's premium account for the term and installment given, dated today, for the amount given, and raises the policy's premium balance by that amount. Afterwards the late charge is visible against that installment and the balance owed is higher.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool. The agent first unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, passing the tool name `assess_late_charge_664a192e` and its arguments.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `renters_policy_id` | Reference number of the RentGuard renters policy record whose installment is overdue, as returned by the renters policy lookup for the customer | Text id |
| `term_effective_date` | Start date of the policy term the overdue installment belongs to, copied from that installment's billing entry | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `installment_number` | Position of the overdue installment within its term (1 is the opening installment of the term), copied from that installment's billing entry | Integer 0 to 12 |
| `amount` | The late charge | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, already rounded half-up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new fee entry reference, the term start date and installment number it is charged against, the charge in USD with 2 decimal places and the premium balance now owed; receiving it means the charge is posted.
